rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a rail you hold while using stairs, ramps, or walkways.

example.english: Remember to hold the handrail when going downstairs.
example.traditional: 落樓梯嗰陣記住捉實扶手。
example.jyutping: lok6 lau4 tai1 go2 zan6 gei3 zyu6 zuk1 sat6 fu4 sau2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the moving belt-like handrail on an escalator.

example.english: Don't stand so close to the handrail on the escalator.
example.traditional: 搭扶手電梯嗰陣唔好企咁近扶手帶。
example.jyutping: daap3 fu4 sau2 din6 tai1 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 kei5 gam3 kan5 fu4 sau2 daai2
